_meta.description: Context manifest for the NFL BETTING product agent. Defines model, context loader steps, tool schemas, persistence, and display config.

contextLoader.label: current_picks
contextLoader.description: Load open picks and bets from localStorage
contextLoader.inject: Merge into a single array of open picks + bets. Label source (picks vs bankroll). Include: team, line, odds, bet_type, result, date_placed, amount_units.

contextLoader.label: bankroll_config
contextLoader.description: Load bankroll configuration for exposure checks
contextLoader.inject: Extract: unit_size, current_balance, max_daily_units, max_single_bet_units. If missing, use defaults: unit_size=25, max_daily_units=10, max_single_bet_units=3.

contextLoader.label: futures_portfolio
contextLoader.description: Load open futures positions and exposure
contextLoader.inject: Include: team, market, odds_at_entry, stake, current_odds_estimate, exposure. Use for hedge calculations.

contextLoader.label: today_context
contextLoader.description: Inject current date, NFL week, and active game count
contextLoader.inject: Today's date, current NFL week (derived from schedule), number of games today and this week.

tools.name: log_pick
tools.description: Record a new pick or bet to the Creator's tracker

notes.description: Rationale or context for the pick

book.description: Sportsbook where the bet is placed

tools.confirmation: Always confirm with Creator before executing. Never auto-log.

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Retrieve current odds from all 8 sportsbooks for a given game
tools.returns: [{ home, away, spread, total, ml_home, ml_away, book, last_updated }]
tools.rateNote: TheOddsAPI: 500 req/month free plan. Prefer Supabase cached data.

tools.name: get_line_movement
tools.description: Return opening vs. current line with directional movement
tools.returns: { game, open_spread, current_spread, open_total, current_total, direction, magnitude, sharp_flag }

tools.name: analyze_matchup
tools.description: Return model projections and intel summary for an NFL game
tools.returns: { home_proj, away_proj, predicted_margin, predicted_total, key_intel_bullets[], model_confidence }

tools.name: get_injury_report
tools.description: Return current injury designations for both teams

team_id.description: ESPN team ID or team abbreviation

tools.name: calculate_hedge
tools.description: Calculate hedge amounts for profit locking or loss cutting

tools.name: calculate_teaser
tools.description: Evaluate teaser value — checks key number crossings (3, 7) and Wong qualification

tools.name: search_podcast_picks
tools.description: Search recent expert picks from tracked podcasts. Use for team-, expert-, week-, and category-filtered podcast-derived betting intel. Excludes picks flagged needs_review.

team.description: Team abbreviation (KC, BUF, ...) to filter by

season.description: NFL season year; defaults to current

tools.returns: [{ expert, show, published_at, category, subject, selection, line, odds_american, units, confidence, quality_score, summary }]

tools.name: get_expert_history
tools.description: Return recent podcast pick history for one expert with category breakdown so the BETTING agent can cite who is active in sides/totals/moneyline/futures/props.

tools.name: get_team_podcast_intel
tools.description: Return picks for and against a specific team across recent podcast episodes, grouped by expert and side. Useful for matchup sentiment and team-level podcast consensus.

tools.name: get_weekly_consensus
tools.description: Cross-expert weekly consensus board from podcast picks, grouped by matchup and side so BETTING can surface sharp alignment or contrarian splits.

season.description: NFL season year; defaults to current

tools.returns: [{ matchup, category, side, expert_count, experts[], average_confidence }]

tools.name: get_futures_movement
tools.description: Return a timeline of expert picks for a specific futures market, ordered oldest-first, so BETTING or FUTURES can discuss line-decay and sentiment movement.

market.description: Futures market identifier such as AFC_North, MVP, or NFC_East_winner

tools.returns: [{ expert, show, published_at, market, selection, odds_american, confidence, summary }]

tools.name: get_player_prop_context
tools.description: Return recent expert prop picks for a single player and prop type, including OVER/UNDER trend counts and podcast rationale.

player.description: Player full name or partial match

prop_type.description: Prop market identifier such as pass_yds, rush_yds, or receptions

tools.name: search_episode_vault_notes
tools.description: List podcast episode vault note paths under NFL/Podcasts/. Use to find the exact vault path for an episode before calling read_vault_note to load picks, intel, and transcript index. Also use to enumerate available episodes for a show.

show.description: Show name or partial match. Omit to list all shows.

episode.description: Episode number or pub_date substring (e.g. 1011 or 2026-06). Optional.

tools.returns: { total_matched, available_shows[], notes[{ path, show, pub_date, episode }], usage_hint }

tools.name: get_youtube_futures_intel
tools.description: S300/S301: local-only, human-reviewed YouTube/Gemini podcast intel research context (11 futures-eligible episodes, 39 promoted items; 1 bad DET division_winner +1500 extraction rejected). Distinct from search_podcast_picks: reads a local JSON file synced to public/, not Supabase. Every item carries source episode/timestamp, supporting_quote, and review_flags (e.g. price_not_in_quote) — always surface review_flags when citing an item. Never an official pick, production recommendation, or Supabase-backed source.

team.description: Team abbreviation (KC, BUF, ATL, ...) to filter by

market.description: Market identifier to filter by (e.g. division_winner, make_playoffs, mvp, win_total)

tools.returns: { status, guardrail, generated_at, total_matched, returned, items[{ item_id, lane, team, market, side, line, price, speaker, rationale, supporting_quote, review_flags[], reviewer_notes, source }] }
